examples.arabic: بالليل، كلوا عشا لذيذ عملته ماما في المطبخ.
examples.english: At night, they ate a delicious dinner that Mom made in the kitchen.
examples.transliteration: Bel leil, kalou 3asha laziz 3amalto Mama fel matbakh.

examples.arabic: كل الاهل بيتجمعوا في البيت على العشا
examples.english: All the family gathers at home for dinner.
examples.transliteration: Kol el ahl byetgama'u fel beet 'ala el 'asha

examples.arabic: وبعدين انا رايحه اشتري حاجات من السوق عشان العشا بتاع الليله
examples.english: And then I am going to buy things from the market for tonight's dinner.
examples.transliteration: Waba'adein ana rayha ashtiri hagat min es souq ashan el asha beta' el leila.

examples.arabic: هنشتري حاجات بسيطة للغدا والعشا وناخد العربية
examples.english: We will buy simple things for lunch and dinner and take the car.
examples.transliteration: Hanestari hagat baseeta lel-ghada wel-asha we nakhed el-arabeya

examples.arabic: على العشا شاف سمك و رز و خضار
examples.english: At dinner, he saw fish, rice, and vegetables.
examples.transliteration: ʕala l-ʕasha shāf samak w rozz w khoḍaar.

examples.english: Mom ordered me to finish before dinner.
